title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dear Muftisab, My friend is a namaazi but he drinks beer sometimes. I want to know as to how much time he should not pray if he drinks beer. Please note, that he is not in nasha if he drinks beer as he drinks very little of the same Regards! 5925 views Q. Jahri @ Sirri Qiraat in prayers? 17016 views Q. Please, tell me about pant or Paijama length is it permissable upto down feet but maximum people only prayer time make it up we should do it same or we have to reduce our cloth length upto (Takhna)? 4728 views Q. Closing one's eyes in salah 2420 views Q. During the jama'at salaah of more than 2 rak'ats, sometimes I forgetfully start reciting 'Darood-e-Ibrahim' after 'At-Tahiyyat' of the 2nd rak'at until I realise myself or the Imam says 'Allahu Akbar' to get up for the 3rd rak'at. I'd like to know whether 'Sajda-e-Sahu' will be wajib on me and should I do 'Sajda-e-Sahu' after the Imam says the 1st salaam? Kindly provide me the fatwa for the following two cases: Case# 1: When I join the jama'at right from the 1st rak'at. Case# 2: When I miss the 1st rak'at and join from 2nd rak'at onwards. 2275 views Q. Is it permisible to perform salah behind an imam who is a blind person? If he is well educated 4120 views Q. Rules of Namaz during travel and at permanent resident 2315 views Q. Assalamualikum, We live in Los Angeles,USA. We have been praying our Jummah and other Satat in a rented place for a long time. It is not a parmanent masjid.From the last Ramadan we started second Jumma Jamat in the same place. Can we offer second Jumma Jamat or second Jamat for any other prayer in the same place? Please let us know. May Allah bless us all. 1804 views Q. Awarness about wajibat 3393 views Q. I would like to ask you regarding the permissibility of children (na-baligh) standing in the rows of adults in the masjid. In our masjid (in London, UK), 2 groups seem to have developed. 1 group says it is necessary for the children to stand in the rows at the back of the congregation during salaat, whereas the other says children should/can stand within the adult rows. Both groups quote different ulama to support their views. Can you please enlighten us with the BEST PRACTICE which should ideally be promoted and followed in our masjid (ie, what should we TRY to do in our masjid, regardless of whether the masallees will follow it or not)? 3494 views Q. Assalam O Alaikum, This is regarding Fatwa ID No. 14851. Alhamdulillah you have already replied my earlier questions. But people are not satisfied with this reply they say you have not asked the question clearly. Now I would like to tell you the incident in detail, what was happened in our Masjid. "One day Imam lead salah from the first row, after the salah one of the muqtadi who is also a knowledgable person objurgate Imam for this act (To lead salah from the first row). He told Imam that this is undesirable (Mukrooh) to lead salah from the first row without having any proper reason. He further said I have already asked you to stop this act then what is the proble with you? Kindly send an early reply. Allah Hafiz 3046 views Q. Azan Recitation Before Time 3224 views Q. Position of rukuh while offering nawafil after witr 1989 views Q. Dear Mufti Sab, Asalamalikum, Kinldy answer the following questions: 1. How to perform Namaaz in Aeroplane, if we performed namaaz by sitting on seat, can this Namaaz required to be repeated later. 2. during our travel from Riyadh to Medinah or Makkah, can we perform both Namaaz at one time(i.e Zuhr and Asar)sometime the bus driver will not stop for Namaaz for Zuhr or Asar separately. 3. i did not receive answer to fatwa ID 11766 Thanks! 2115 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40796 Country: India Title: sunnah prayer Question: Is it mandatory to offer sunnah salah at home or if it is not, then is it acceptable in Islam to offer sunnah salah at home? Answer ID: 40796 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/1301/M=1433) It is not necessary and wajib to offer sunnah salah (which are offered before or after the fardh salah) at home, however it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
